candidate_learnings.statement: An authorization token for an irreversible action must cryptographically BIND to every parameter defining the action (source, amount, destination, dedup key) + be single-use + expiring + constant-time compared.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Enumerate the full parameter set of the gated action; assert each is a MAC input; test mutating each bound field -> reject, cross-action replay -> reject, reuse/expiry -> reject.

candidate_learnings.statement: A credential/flag presence-CHECKED at a gate but never WIRED into the client performing the gated op is a recurring latent gap: the gate passes while the privileged call runs with wrong/default creds.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Trace the gated resource from gate to call site; require a test that the privileged (mocked) path consumes the write-scoped credential, not the default. Treat 'flag parsed but never consumed' as its own defect class.

candidate_learnings.statement: Audit/PII minimisation must be allowlist-at-write (build the record from explicit permitted fields), never deny-by-shape regex (fail-open + corrupts legit numeric fields like a >=6-digit total).
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Require field-by-field allowlist construction; forbid raw-through-scrubber. Test: no full PAN/secret in output AND a large legitimate numeric survives unmangled.

candidate_learnings.statement: A persisted counter gating an irreversible action must increment atomically with the state burn, committed BEFORE the dependent partner write, and re-read under a single ordering pre-execution; else a crash window or same-cycle race exceeds the cap / double-acts.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Specify commit ordering explicitly. Test: under-cap item pushing aggregate over -> blocked; two items one cycle can't both pass; total survives fresh process.

candidate_learnings.statement: Placeholder secrets in .env.example/sample config must be rejected at load/first use; a copy-verbatim deploy otherwise runs a known public signing key (forgeable tokens) while presence checks pass.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Reject known placeholder/sentinel values at config load and at crypto use; test that loading verbatim .env.example for a security secret fails closed. presence != validity.

candidate_learnings.statement: A new operable surface must emit a machine-readable envelope on BOTH success and error with a deterministic exit code; success-only JSON / hardcoded return 0 hides failures from automation. Every parsed flag must be consumed.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: Require a symmetric failure envelope + non-zero exit per failure class; headless test asserting error shape + rc; verify no inert flags.

candidate_learnings.statement: Extend a frozen-behaviour codebase via one isolated subpackage with additions-only edits to shared files, gated by a git-diff freeze check proving existing signatures/behaviour byte-identical and protected dirs (migrations/views) empty-diff.
candidate_learnings.catch_next_time: List every existing file touched, justify each as additions-only; gate build on git-diff: existing --help/signatures unchanged, migrations/views empty diff, full prior suite green.
